title: BlueCloud Launcher 0.7.2 - Slide Cloud
notes: Slide Cloud 0.1.0 joins Doc Cloud and Sheet Cloud as a free Windows alpha app. New orange squircle logo, editable slides, local templates and autosave, speaker notes, slideshow, native backups and basic PPTX import/export. Updated catalog and signed download systems; existing apps, profiles and download/recovery controls are preserved.
